entries.text: Why hello there, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_01

entries.text: You always seem to appear at the most crucial\nof moments.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_02

entries.text: The most crucial of moments?
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_select_01

entries.text: Is something going on?
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_select_02

entries.text: Well, you see...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_03

entries.text: Master Hassel. I am here to collect you.
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_01

entries.text: So I see.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_04

entries.text: I’m glad that you’ve finally made up your mind\nabout taking your place as leader of the family.
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_02

entries.text: It is indeed true that I have made up my mind.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_06

entries.text: I have made up my mind to continue teaching\nhere at the academy![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_07

entries.text: H-how could you?! Are you saying you don’t care\nwhat happens to our proud lineage?!
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_03

entries.text: I am saying that I have other priorities![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_08

entries.text: Have a look around at the art decorating this\nroom, would you?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_09

entries.text: The children here are letting their senses—their\nperceptiveness—grow freely![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_10

entries.text: I do not wish to say that protecting our family’s\nancient bloodline is of no importance...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_11

entries.text: I simply wish to see young talent blossom and\ngrow into the future.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_12

entries.text: It just seems so much more fun to me, if I’m\nbeing honest![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_13

entries.text: What utter nonsense.
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_04

entries.text: And yet...
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_05

entries.text: Your fearless, unflinching commitment to that\nnonsensical vision proves that you’re worthy of\r\ncarrying the will of the dragons, Master Hassel.
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_06

entries.text: I will not give up. I will come as many times as I\nneed to in order to change your mind.
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_07

entries.text: Oh, by all means, my door is open! I think you’ll\nsoon find you’ve met your match in stubbornness.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_14

entries.text: You thought I could be cowed by some story\nspun up about my father’s deteriorating health?\r\nI am not so easily fooled![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_15

entries.text: Tch! I will return another day!
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_tamer_08

entries.text: Ah, I’m sorry you had to see all of that.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_16

entries.text: I was so very close to resigning my post as\nteacher and returning to my home...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_17

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]but the students here gave me courage to say no.
That includes you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Your
words
truly
brought
me strength.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_18

entries.text: I cannot think of a way I can possibly repay my\ndebt to you young ones.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_19

entries.text: Take this, if you will—insufficient as it may be in\nexpressing the full breadth of my gratitude.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_20

entries.text: Now then! Let it be clear to all![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_21

entries.text: I, Hassel, will continue on my chosen path as\ninstructor to the youths of our world![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_22

entries.text: You formed a close bond with Mr. Hassel!
entries.label: kizuna_dragon_d_system_01
